title: Patch: quasi-3D models for the Mythics: each Mythic a diorama of its own, turned by a drag in inspect, with an idle loop of its own and its takeover flown through it
notes: How cards look only: nothing plays differently. Every Mythic card and every token printed Mythic (50 cards) draws a diorama of its own where a face draws depth planes (R3344000): its still picture cut, by a file written for that card, into five to eight depth slices (DIORAMA_SLICES_MIN, DIORAMA_SLICES_MAX), some bent about one axis to read as a curved surface (DIORAMA_BEND_MAX_DEG), two or more on an idle loop written for the card in transform and opacity alone (Zephrys's gusts circling, Dice of Doom's die turning, Alteran Reach's lights coming on along its path, Ceaseless Void's sparks falling at every depth). A slice draws only the picture's own pieces, so no colour, text or byte the picture lacks (R2725004, ART_DETAIL_MAX_BYTES). In inspect, the hover preview, the Collection and the full-screen view a diorama turns up to DIORAMA_TURN_MAX_DEG, in hand CARD_TILT_MAX_DEG; its loops run inside the motion slots (R3340000), in hand, inspect and on the board, where a moving Mythic Unit draws every slice in its window; the full-screen view draws the slices, and a Mythic's takeover flies through them (R3345000). Alt art and the restyles draw no diorama, and reduced motion, the system's setting and the fx intensity off draw the flat picture, still. R3350000.

player.title: Mythic dioramas
new: Every Mythic card, and every token printed Mythic, is now a small 3D model of its picture: a diorama of five to eight layers made for that card, some of them curved.
Drag a Mythic in inspect, or move the pointer over it in the preview or the Collection, and it turns up to 25 degrees each way, its layers sliding past each other.
On a phone, drag it in inspect, or tilt the phone once Tilt with my phone is on.
Each diorama has an animation of its own: Zephrys's wind circling, Dice of Doom's die turning, Alteran Reach's lights coming on along its path, Ceaseless Void's falling sparks.
The animation plays in your hand, in inspect and on the board.
A Mythic's full-screen view shows its diorama, and its takeover flies the camera through it.
changes: Alt art keeps its own picture, and Reduce motion, your system's reduced-motion setting and effects intensity Off show the flat picture, standing still.
